items.control_name: Enable Multi-Region CloudTrail with Log File Validation
items.description: An organizational multi-region trail must be enabled with log file validation and KMS encryption.
items.current_value: Org Trail 'org-security-trail' active; Log File Validation = TRUE
items.remediation_notes: Verify KMS key policy allows CloudTrail encryption across all accounts.

items.control_name: Enable AWS GuardDuty across all Operating Regions
items.description: GuardDuty must be enabled with Kubernetes, S3, and RDS protection plans active.
items.current_value: Enabled in us-east-1 and us-west-2; S3 protection active
items.recommended_value: GuardDuty active in 100% of enabled regions with EKS/S3/RDS protection
items.remediation_notes: Forward GuardDuty findings via EventBridge to SIEM / PagerDuty.

items.control_name: Enable AWS Config Continuous Recording for All Resources
items.description: AWS Config must record all supported resource types, including global IAM resources.
items.current_value: Config recorder active in us-east-1; missing in us-west-2
items.recommended_value: AWS Config enabled organization-wide with central aggregator
items.remediation_notes: Deploy AWS Config Aggregator in security logging account.

items.control_name: Enable AWS Security Hub with CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
items.description: Security Hub must be enabled in central security account with CIS Foundations standard active.
items.current_value: Security Hub active; CIS Foundations score = 84%
items.recommended_value: Security Hub enabled across all accounts; target CIS score >= 90%
items.remediation_notes: Address medium/high findings in IAM and S3 control groups.
